balls.name: Bleed
balls.effect: Inflicts 2 stacks of bleed. Bleeding enemies receive 1 damage per stack when hit by a ball (max 8 stacks).

balls.name: Brood Mother
balls.effect: Has a 25% chance of birthing a baby ball each time it hits an enemy.

balls.name: Burn
balls.effect: Add 1 stack of burn on hit for 3 seconds (max 3 stacks). Burnt units are dealt 4–8 damage per stack per second.

balls.name: Cell
balls.effect: Splits into a clone on hit 2 times.

balls.name: Charm
balls.effect: Each hit has a 4% chance of charming the enemy for 5 seconds. Charmed units walk up the board and attack enemies.

balls.name: Dark
balls.effect: Deals 3.0x damage but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.

balls.name: Earthquake
balls.effect: Deals 5–13 damage to nearby units in a 3x3 tile square.

balls.name: Egg Sac
balls.effect: Explodes into 2–4 baby balls on hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.

balls.name: Flesh
balls.effect: Speed increases by 25% per bounce.

balls.name: Freeze
balls.effect: Has a 4% chance to freeze enemies for 5.0 seconds. Frozen enemies receive 25% more damage.

balls.name: Ghost
balls.effect: Passes through enemies.

balls.name: Iron
balls.effect: Deals double damage but moves 40% slower.

balls.name: Laser (Horizontal)
balls.effect: Deals 9–18 damage to all enemies in the same row.

balls.name: Laser (Vertical)
balls.effect: Deals 9–18 damage to all enemies in the same column.

balls.name: Light
balls.effect: Blinds enemies on hit for 3 seconds. Blinded units have a hard time detecting you and have a 50% chance of missing when they attack.

balls.name: Lightning
balls.effect: Deals 1–20 damage to up to 3 nearby enemies.

balls.name: Poison
balls.effect: Applies 1 stack of poison on hit (max 5 stacks). Poison lasts for 6 seconds and each stack deals 1–4 damage per second.

balls.name: Stone
balls.effect: Initially deals 300% damage. Damage erodes by 40% each time hitting an enemy (minimum 50%).

balls.name: Time
balls.effect: Explodes into a time snare upon hitting an enemy, which stays on the field for 20 seconds and freezes enemies inside it.

balls.name: Vampire
balls.effect: Each hit has a 4.5% chance of healing 1 health.

balls.name: Wind
balls.effect: Passes through enemies and slows them down by 30% for 5 seconds, but deals 25% less damage.

balls.name: Baby Ball
balls.effect: Base attack ball, no special abilities. All characters start with a few except The Empty Nester and The Makeshift Sisyphus.

balls.name: Armageddon
balls.effect: Creates a meteor shower upon hitting an enemy. The meteor shower lasts for 5 seconds and deals 30–50 damage/second to enemies within a 3 tile radius.

balls.name: Assassin
balls.effect: Passes through the front of enemies, but not the back. Backstabs deal 30% bonus damage.

balls.name: Banished Flame
balls.effect: Add 1 stack of darkflame on hit for 2 seconds (max 6 stacks). Darkflame deals 1–30 damage per stack per second. When the darkflame goes out, it deals 1–100 to the enemy.

balls.name: Banshee
balls.effect: Curses all enemies while on the field when launched. Cursed enemies are dealt 150–300 after being hit 6 times.

balls.name: Berserk
balls.effect: Each hit has a 30% chance of causing enemies to go berserk for 6 seconds. Berserk enemies deal 15–24 damage to adjacent enemies every second.

balls.name: Black Hole
balls.effect: Instantly kills the first non-boss enemy that it hits, but destroys itself afterwards. Has a 7 second cooldown before it can be shot again.

balls.name: Blizzard
balls.effect: Freezes all enemies within a 2 tile radius for 0.8 seconds, dealing 1–50 damage.

balls.name: Bomb
balls.effect: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing 150–300 damage to nearby enemies. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.

balls.name: Brimstone
balls.effect: Applies 1 stack of burn and poison every second to all enemies within a 2 tile radius (max 4 stacks).

balls.name: Catapult
balls.effect: Launches 3–5 stone baby balls every 1.5 seconds, which are destroyed after hitting anything.

balls.name: Drill
balls.effect: Pierces enemies and deals 50% bonus damage until reaching the back of the field.

balls.name: Elemental
balls.effect: Applies a random status effect (burn, slow, or freeze) to nearby enemies on hit.

balls.name: Erosion
balls.effect: Passes through enemies. Deals 3% of enemy's current health as bonus damage on hit.

balls.name: Fireworks
balls.effect: Explodes into 3–6 fireworks. Fireworks target random enemies, dealing 20–30 damage and applying 1 stack of burn.

balls.name: Flash
balls.effect: Damages all enemies on screen for 1–3 damage after hitting an enemy and blinds them for 2 seconds.

balls.name: Flesh Mound
balls.effect: Emits a fleshy baby ball in a random direction every 1.0 seconds.

balls.name: Flicker
balls.effect: Deals 1–7 damage to every enemy on screen every 1.4 seconds.

balls.name: Freeze Ray
balls.effect: Emits a freeze ray when hitting an enemy, dealing 20–50 to all enemies in its path, with a 10% chance of freezing them for 10.0 seconds.

balls.name: Frozen Flame
balls.effect: Add 1 stack of frostburn on hit for 20 seconds (max 4 stacks). Frostburnt units are dealt 8–12 damage per stack per second and receive 25% more damage from other sources.

balls.name: Glacier
balls.effect: Releases glacial spikes over time that deal 15–30 to enemies that touch them and freeze them for 2.0 seconds. This ball and its glacial spikes also deal 6–12 damage to nearby units.

balls.name: Heart Swallower
balls.effect: Saps enemies on hit, with a 40% chance of stealing 1 health and reducing their attack damage by 20%.

balls.name: Hemorrhage
balls.effect: Inflicts 3 stacks of bleed. When hitting an enemy with 12+ stacks of bleed, consumes all stacks to deal 20% of their current health.

balls.name: Holy Laser
balls.effect: Deals 24–36 damage to all enemies in the same row and column.

balls.name: Incubus
balls.effect: Each hit has a 4% chance of charming the enemy for 9 seconds. Charmed enemies curse nearby enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt 100–200 after being hit 5 times.

balls.name: Inferno
balls.effect: Applies 1 stack of burn every second to all enemies within a 2 tile radius. Burn lasts for 6 seconds, dealing 3–7 damage per stack per second.

balls.name: Landslide
balls.effect: Creates a landslide and destroys self upon hitting an enemy. The landslide lasts for 5 seconds and deals 20–30 damage per second to enemies within a 2 tile radius.

balls.name: Laser Beam
balls.effect: Emits a laser beam on hit that deals 30–42 damage and blinds enemies for 8 seconds.

balls.name: Laser Cutter
balls.effect: Constantly emits a laser in front of it, which deals 100–150 damage per second.

balls.name: Leech
balls.effect: Attaches up to 1 leech onto enemies it hits, which adds 2 stacks of bleed per second (max 24 stacks).

balls.name: Lightning Bug
balls.effect: Spawns a lightning bug each time it hits an enemy. Lightning bugs attack a random enemy, dealing 1–80 damage to up to 3 nearby enemies.

balls.name: Lightning Rod
balls.effect: Plants a lightning rod into enemies it hits. These enemies are struck by lightning every 3.0 seconds, dealing 1–30 damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.

balls.name: Lovestruck
balls.effect: Inflicts lovestruck on hit enemies for 20 seconds. Lovestruck units have a 50% chance of healing you for 5 health when they attack.

balls.name: Maggot
balls.effect: Infests enemies on hit with maggots. When they die, they explode into 1–2 baby balls.

balls.name: Magma
balls.effect: Emits lava blobs over time. Enemies who walk into lava blobs are dealt 15–30 damage and gain 1 stack of burn (max 3 stacks). This ball and its lava blobs also deal 6–12 damage to nearby units.

balls.name: Mosquito King
balls.effect: Spawns a mosquito each time it hits an enemy. Mosquitos attack a random enemy, dealing 80–120 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 1 health.

balls.name: Mosquito Kingdom
balls.effect: Spawns 1–2 mosquitos each time it hits an enemy. Mosquitos attack a random enemy, dealing 100–150 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 2 health.

balls.name: Mosquito Swarm
balls.effect: Explodes into 3–6 mosquitos. Mosquitos attack random enemies, dealing 80–120 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 1 health.

balls.name: Nosferatu
balls.effect: Spawns a vampire bat each bounce. Vampire bats fly towards a random enemy, dealing 132–176 damage on hit, turning into a Vampire Lord.

balls.name: Noxious
balls.effect: Passes through enemies and applies 3 stacks of poison to nearby enemies within a 2 tile radius. Poison lasts for 4 seconds and each stack deals 1–3 damage per second.

balls.name: Nuclear Bomb
balls.effect: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing 300–500 damage to nearby enemies and applying 1 stack of radiation to everyone present indefinitely (max 5 stacks). Each stack of radiation increases damage received by 10%. Has a 3 second cooldown.

balls.name: Offspring
balls.effect: Splits into a clone on hit 4 times.

balls.name: Overgrowth
balls.effect: Applies 1 stack of overgrowth. Upon reaching 3, consume all stacks and deal 150–200 damage to all enemies in a 3x3 tile square.

balls.name: Petrify
balls.effect: Petrifies all enemies within its sightline for 1.5 seconds when first launched, dealing 50–120.

balls.name: Phantom
balls.effect: Curses enemies on hit. Cursed enemies are dealt 100–200 damage after being hit 5 times.

balls.name: Radiation Beam
balls.effect: Emits a radiation beam on hit that deals 24–48 damage and applies 1 stack of radiation (max 5 stacks, +10% damage taken per stack, 15 s).

balls.name: Reaper
balls.effect: Has a 10% chance to kill enemies on impact, healing you for 5 health.

balls.name: Sacrifice
balls.effect: Inflicts 4 stacks of bleed (max 15 stacks) and applies curse to hit enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt 50–100 after being hit 5 times.

balls.name: Sandstorm
balls.effect: Goes through enemies and is surrounded by a raging storm dealing 10–20 damage per second and blinding nearby enemies for 3 seconds.

balls.name: Satan
balls.effect: While active, adds 1 stack of burn to all active enemies per second (max 5 stacks, 10–20 damage per stack per second) and makes them go berserk (15–24 damage to adjacent enemies every second).

balls.name: Shotgun
balls.effect: Shoots 3–7 iron baby balls after hitting a wall. Iron baby balls move at 200% speed but are destroyed upon hitting anything.

balls.name: Sniper
balls.effect: Pierces enemies and shoots 3–7 sniper baby balls after hitting a wall. Sniper baby balls pierce enemies but are destroyed upon hitting a wall.

balls.name: Soul Sucker
balls.effect: Passes through enemies and saps them, with a 30% chance of stealing 1 health and reducing their attack damage by 20%.

balls.name: Spider Queen
balls.effect: Has a 25% chance of birthing an Egg Sac each time it hits an enemy.

balls.name: Steel
balls.effect: Initially deals double damage but moves 50% slower. Damage increases by 10% each time it hits an enemy (max 300%).

balls.name: Storm
balls.effect: Emits lightning to strike nearby enemies every second, dealing 1–40 damage.

balls.name: Succubus
balls.effect: Each hit has a 4% chance of charming the enemy for 9 seconds. Heals 1 when hitting a charmed enemy.

balls.name: Sun
balls.effect: Blinds all enemies in view and adds 1 stack of burn every second (max 5 stacks). Burn lasts for 6 seconds and deals 6–12 damage per stack per second.

balls.name: Swamp
balls.effect: Leaves behind tar blobs over time. Enemies who walk into tar blobs are dealt 15–30, are slowed by 50% for 7 seconds and gain 1 stack of poison (max 8 stacks). This ball and its tar blobs also deal 6–12 damage to nearby units.

balls.name: Time Bomb
balls.effect: Throws a time bomb every few seconds, which explodes after a delay, dealing 80–120 damage to nearby enemies.

balls.name: Timestop
balls.effect: Freezes everything on the field for 5.0 seconds but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a 30 second cooldown.

balls.name: Tumor
balls.effect: Applies tumor on hit. Enemies with a tumor die after 40 seconds (except for bosses).

balls.name: Vampire Lord
balls.effect: Each hit inflicts 3 stacks of bleed. Heals 1 health and consumes all stacks when hitting an enemy with at least 10 stacks of bleed.

balls.name: Venom
balls.effect: Applies 1 stack of venom on hit (max 8 stacks). Each stack deals 3–6 damage per second and slows down enemies.

balls.name: Virus
balls.effect: Applies 1 stack of disease to units it hits (max 8 stacks). Disease lasts 6 seconds; each stack deals 3–6 damage per second, and diseased units have a 15% chance per second of passing a stack to nearby enemies.

balls.name: Voluptuous Egg Sac
balls.effect: Explodes into 2–3 egg sacs on hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown.

balls.name: Warp
balls.effect: After each hit, warps to a random spot on the field and speeds up by 5%.

balls.name: Wraith
balls.effect: Freezes any enemy it passes through for 0.8 seconds.

balls.name: X Ray
balls.effect: Emits an X-shaped laser on hit, which deals 50–75 damage to enemies and applies 1 stack of radiation (max 5 stacks; +10% damage taken per stack).

balls.name: Zombie
balls.effect: Infects enemies on hit, giving them a 40% chance to turn into a friendly zombie on death.

passives.name: Archer's Effigy
passives.effect: Every 7–12 rows, spawn a stone archer with 160 health on your side. Shoots arrows at enemies, dealing 10–20 each. Immune to ball damage.

passives.name: Artificial Heart
passives.effect: Friendly pieces gain 100% more health

passives.name: Bandage Roll

passives.effect: Decrease damage taken by 10%

passives.name: Cursed Elixir

passives.name: Everflowing Goblet

passives.name: Eye of the Beholder
passives.effect: 10% chance to dodge incoming attacks

passives.name: Fleet Feet
passives.effect: Increase movement speed by 10% and move at full speed while shooting

passives.name: Frozen Spike
passives.effect: When an enemy is frozen, they emit a chill to nearby enemies that deals 10–20 damage

passives.name: Gemspring
passives.effect: Every 7–11 rows, spawn a Gemspring. Damaging it drops an increasing amount of XP gems

passives.effect: Balls go through enemies and deal 20% bonus damage when hitting them from the side

passives.name: Ghostly Shield
passives.effect: Balls go through allies and heal them for 2 health

passives.name: Golden Bull
passives.effect: Every 7–11 rows, spawn a golden bull with 400 health; accrues 10 gold/minute; moves up the field blocking/attacking

passives.name: Hand Mirror

passives.name: Healer's Effigy

passives.effect: Balls deal 150% damage, but damage decays by 30% each bounce (min 50%)

passives.name: Kiss of Death

passives.name: Lover's Quiver
passives.effect: Projectiles have a 40% chance to heal you for 1 health instead of hurting you

passives.name: Magic Staff
passives.effect: Increase area-of-effect damage (earthquake, laser, lightning) by 20%

passives.name: Magnet
passives.effect: Increase range at which you pick up items and catch balls by 1.0 tiles

passives.name: Platinum Dumbbell

passives.name: Pressure Valve

passives.name: Protective Charm

passives.effect: Increases ball launch speed by 20%, but you get knocked back a little each shot

passives.effect: Increase crit chance to 20% when hitting enemies in the same column as you

passives.effect: Balls start at 70% speed but increase by 20% each bounce (max 200%)

passives.effect: Increase crit chance to 15% when hitting enemies in the back

passives.effect: Increase crit chance to 30% when hitting enemies on their left side

passives.effect: Increase fire rate by 15%

passives.effect: Increase crit chance to 20% when hitting blinded enemies

passives.name: Silver Bullet
passives.effect: Balls deal 20% bonus damage until they hit a wall

passives.effect: 25% chance to launch a baby ball when you pick up a gem

passives.effect: Deal 30–50 to enemies the first time you get into their melee attack range

passives.effect: Balls deal 40% less damage, but gain 1% damage for each enemy on the field

passives.effect: Stone allies can now be damaged by your balls, but you heal 2 health when a ball hits one

passives.name: Turret
passives.effect: Floats around your character and shoots a baby ball at enemies every 2.0 seconds

passives.name: Upturned Hatchet
passives.effect: Balls deal 80% more damage after hitting the back of the field, otherwise damage reduced by 20%

passives.effect: Each kill heals you by 5, but each shot you take deals 2 damage to you

passives.effect: Curse has a 10% chance of killing enemies

passives.effect: Each time a ball hits a wall, it deals 30% extra damage on the next hit

passives.effect: Deal 6–12 per second to enemies within 2 tiles

passives.effect: Balls deal 200% damage, but damage decays by 20% each bounce (minimum 100%).

passives.effect: Projectiles no longer hurt you. Shoot 1–2 baby balls when hit by a projectile.

passives.name: Cornucopia
passives.effect: Each time baby balls are created, spawn 0–1 additional baby balls.

passives.name: Deadeye's Cross
passives.effect: Increase critical hit chance to 60%.

passives.effect: Increase critical hit chance to 5%. Critical hits instantly kill non-boss enemies.

passives.name: Full Metal Rapier
passives.effect: Balls deal 1% more damage for each baby ball and enemy on the field.

passives.effect: Critical hits have a 5% chance to instantly kill enemies.

passives.effect: Floats around your character and shoots a random level 1 unevolved special ball at enemies every 8.0 seconds.

passives.effect: When balls hit a wall or the back of the field, they hit a random enemy with 50% bonus damage.

characters.name: The Warrior
characters.quirk: Default character, no special gameplay quirks.

characters.name: The Itchy Finger
characters.quirk: Scattered aim, shoots twice as fast, auto-launches balls; full speed while shooting.

characters.name: The Repentant
characters.quirk: Balls deal +5% damage per bounce; on hitting the back wall they return, damaging enemies passed through.

characters.name: The Cohabitants
characters.quirk: Each launched ball is mirrored by a copy; balls deal half damage.

characters.name: The Cogitator
characters.quirk: Automatically chooses upgrades.

characters.name: The Embedded
characters.quirk: Balls always pierce enemies until they hit a wall.

characters.name: The Shade
characters.quirk: Balls shoot from the back; base crit chance 10%.

characters.name: The Shieldbearer
characters.quirk: Large shield bounces back balls that hit it.

characters.name: The Spendthrift
characters.quirk: Shoots all balls at once in a wide arc.

characters.name: The Juggler
characters.quirk: Lobs balls at a target position; no bouncing until landing.

characters.name: The Empty Nester
characters.quirk: No baby balls. Each shot shoots multiple instances of one equipped special ball.

characters.name: The Flagellant
characters.quirk: Balls bounce normally off the bottom of the screen.

characters.name: The Makeshift Sisyphus
characters.quirk: No baby balls. No direct hit damage; AOE and status damage ×4.

characters.name: The Physicist
characters.quirk: Balls are affected by gravity toward the back of the screen.

characters.name: The Tactician
characters.quirk: Battles become turn-based.

characters.name: The Radical
characters.quirk: Plays the game and chooses upgrades automatically (AI plays).

characters.name: The Falconer
characters.quirk: Balls shot from two falcons on the sides of the screen.

characters.name: The Carouser
characters.quirk: Balls can briefly orbit the player on return trajectory.

characters.name: The Tunneller
characters.quirk: Balls wrap around top and bottom of the screen.

characters.name: The Tiptoer
characters.quirk: Undetectable by enemies (except bosses/minibosses); drastically less health.

characters.name: The Hoary Hoarder
characters.quirk: Only 2 ball slots; remaining equipment slots become passive slots.

characters.name: The Ballbearer
characters.quirk: Twice as many ball slots, but no passive slots.

characters.quirk: Twitch audience votes on choices and random events.
